entities.summary: Giuseppe Vigoni was an Italian explorer and geographer who served as the Mayor of Milan from 1892 to 1894 and again from 1895 to 1899. He was a recipient of the Order of Saints Maurice and Lazarus. He also served in the Senate of the Kingdom of Italy.
